question: Which mechanisms of writing, holding and switching does the three Kerr parametric oscillators on an antiferromagnetic triangle carry, and with which laws?

provenance.source: Goto, Sci. Rep. 6, 21686 (2016); frustrated Ising triangle
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

name: three Kerr parametric oscillators on an antiferromagnetic triangle
closure: loss kappa = 1 into a zero-temperature bath; the vacuum noise of the loss enters as D = kappa/8 per quadrature (truncated Wigner)
observable: signs of x1, x2, x3 (Ising configuration of a frustrated triangle)
